title: Attributes
intro: What you want to know of each email, to organise yourselves: where it stands, how urgent it is, who takes care of it, what it is about. Boards filter on them. Each says how it is decided when an email is sorted.
formIntro: An attribute has a few values. When an email is fetched, a rule can give it one; members can always set it by hand.
name: Name
valuesHint: One per line, for a choice. A “member” attribute takes the members of the organisation.
decidedByHint: The AI decides only the two pre-configured attributes for now, and only where the organisation has it sort.
deciderEloAi: A rule, then the AI where the rule says nothing
fixed: The name and the values of a pre-configured attribute are fixed: the application relies on them.
ruleIntro: Written in Elo, a small expression language: it costs nothing to run and says exactly what it does. It is given the email as _ and answers a value, or null to say nothing.
tryHint: Trying a rule changes nothing: it shows what the rule would say of your twenty most recent emails.
saved: Attribute saved. It applies to the emails fetched from now on.
confirmDelete: Delete the attribute “{name}”? Boards stop filtering on it.
